title: •Danz Borin
caption: •Danz Borin (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. May add 1 to Force drains at same Nal Hutta location. Danz is a matching pilot for any {independent} starship and while piloting one, may not draw more than one battle destiny here (that destiny may not be canceled or modified by opponent).
lore: Cocky gunner and bounty hunter. Maintains a residence on Nar Shaddaa, the spaceport moon of the Hutt homeworld. To his companions’ delight, he’s nearly as good as he boasts.

notes: Sheet group: Everything else. Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2, third box empty (printed POWER 1 / ABILITY 2); deploy 2 / forfeit 4 (printed 2 / 3). Yellow DS pilot icon + '3.' → {pilot:3}. Inline blue spoked wheel before 'starship' = Independent → {independent} (stub: 'Starship icon named' — it is the Independent icon). Icon column: pilot (as printed). Alien. Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by Tyler Vastag' / 'Twin Cities V-Lite 2006' → credit_bottom. LORE corrected: curly apostrophes companions’, he’s. 'bounty hunter' is plain on the printed 350 px decipher-archive scan (used as src, it is the wiki base page's image); the 745 px ANH-D-danzborin.gif is the PC errata face (corner D-E1, game text 'Adds 1 to weapon destiny draws of anything he is aboard as a passenger') with bold 'bounty hunter' — downloaded to src/vs15/43-ANH-D-danzborin.gif for art only. Copyright 1996 (ANH) legible enough. Modern: V22-D-danzborin.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 22 Danz Borin (V), same lore/art, bold 'bounty hunter'); VB1-D-danzborin-pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
